name: Agent MCP Server
description: MCP server that enables LLMs to spawn, delegate to, and coordinate AI agents across multiple providers with session support, DAG task dependencies, human-in-the-loop, and recursive sub-agent delegation.
signature_note: MCP protocol via stdio/SSE, DAG-based task dispatch, provider abstraction layer (Claude, LM Studio, etc.), session/task/prompt/tool persistence via SQLite, usage budgeting and policy enforcement plugins.

name: Agent Registry Environment Resolver
description: Shared @adhd/environment-backed resolver for the agent-registry family's single shared SQLite database. Replaces import-time DB opens with lazy DI pattern.
signature_note: Eliminates import-time side effect (DB open at module load), switches registry family to lazy environment-based resolution, unifies DB path discovery for prompts/tools/policy/provider stores.

name: Apigen CLI: Code-First API Generation
description: CLI tool: write plain TypeScript functions, apigen generates transport-neutral descriptor and projects to HTTP (Fastify/Express), MCP tools, CLI, JSON Schema, OpenAPI, Python (Flask/gRPC).
receipts: entrypoint/apigen-cli/src/index.ts (Commander program, commands: generate, run, serve, list-types)
signature_note: Schema extraction via ts-morph + ts-json-schema-generator, middleware system (logging, health), multi-package gateway composition, wire format conformance for cross-host compatibility.

name: Dispatch CLI: DAG Task Orchestration
description: CLI for validating task DAGs, generating snapshots for cost estimation, optimizing execution paths, and running dispatch cycles with milestone tracking.
receipts: entrypoint/dispatch-cli/src/index.ts (exports validate, snapshot, optimize, eligible, status, run, calibrate)
signature_note: DAG validation with cycle detection, cost-per-milestone snapshot generation for budget planning, route optimization (topological sort + cost minimization), live dispatch cycle execution with cancellation and error recovery.

name: Environment: Zero-Config Cascade
description: Cascading configuration system for @adhd ecosystem: code defaults → system → global (~/.adhd) → project → local → env vars. Fully optional — no files required, pure TypeScript, safe for Node and browser.
verify: npx tsx -e "const {Environment}=await import('@adhd/environment');const e=new Environment('test',{});console.log(typeof e.get)"
signature_note: Cascade resolution with type-safe config, advisory locking for multi-instance collision avoidance, snapshot persistence for cross-process state sharing, scope auto-detection (project vs global), remappable env var prefix.

name: Apigen Plugin System
description: Transport plugins that project the same operation descriptor to multiple endpoints: MCP tools, HTTP servers (Fastify/Express), CLI commands, JSON Schema docs, OpenAPI docs, Python servers (Flask/gRPC).
signature_note: Unified operation descriptor across 8 transport plugins, OutputPlugin contract enforced, MCP server uses @adhd/environment for multi-instance port binding (SSE per-instance port derivation).

name: Agent Registry Family
description: 12-package ecosystem for agent execution: base types, policy engine, provider registry, session/task/prompt/tool stores, orchestration engine, and plugins (budget capping, output sanitization).
signature_note: Modular tier hierarchy (base→core→store→engine), shared SQLite via agent-core-env (new, replaces import-time DB opens), policy enforcement with rate limiting and safety checks, Nx generator for scaffold conformance.

name: Workspace Codegen Nx Generator
description: Mandatory package scaffolding generator. Creates tier-correct packages with proper naming (domain-tier-name), tagging, and architectural boundaries. NEVER use @nx/js:library or manual package creation.
verify: npx nx g @adhd/workspace-codegen-nx:types --group test --name example --dry-run 2>&1 | head -5
signature_note: Generator enforces tier/domain/platform/layer/access tags, emits correct project.json structure, prevents upward dependencies and platform isolation violations, integrates with .adhd/workspace.json domain registry.
